metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded using a 128-channel equidistant electrode cap (Easycap GmbH) with an actiCHamp Plus amplifier (Brain Products GmbH) at a sampling rate of 1000 Hz and amplitude resolution of 0.1 μV. Electrode impedances were maintained below 20 kΩ, with a nose reference and two diagonally placed EOG electrodes beneath each eye. Participants completed the Trail Making Test, EEG recording during cognitive tasks and resting-state, and post-session questionnaires assessing fatigue, depression, anxiety, and sleep quality.
